title: Execution Envelope (Clawket v11)
description: 19-field task contract attached to each clawket task. ADR-0001.

version.description: Schema version. v1 only at M0 freeze. ADR-0011 owns forward-migration to v2+.

intent.description: One-paragraph statement of what this task changes and why. Markdown allowed.

target_repo.description: Repository this task may mutate. <org>/<repo> for GitHub, or absolute/relative path for local.

success_criteria.description: Checkable outcomes. Each entry should be a link, command, or assertion.

verification_cmd.description: Single shell command. Exit 0 == success. Captured stdout/stderr attached to run.

decomposition_policy.description: DSL per ADR-0004. atomic | tree(max_depth=N) | linear(max_steps=N) | custom(...).

sha.description: Optional git SHA pinning the referenced state.

context_refs.description: Stable refs to artifacts/tasks/decisions the agent may consult. v1 schema per RL-U3-02.

acceptance_criteria.description: Subset of success_criteria treated as gating-required (vs success_criteria as full set).

precondition.description: Pre-run boolean DSL expression per RL-U2-05. null == always true.

postcondition.description: Post-run boolean DSL expression per RL-U2-05. null == verification_cmd exit 0.

rollback_plan.description: Standard rollback format per RL-U2-08. null == no automated rollback.

assigned_model.description: Declared model class for this task per ADR-0007. Declarative — runtime enforcement is via cycle.allowed_models, not at LLM-call layer. null == unspecified.

retry_policy.description: Retry behaviour per ADR-0008. null == defaults (3, exponential, 0.2, per_file).

secrets_ref.description: Per-secret resolution chain per ADR-0009. Default order = [user_config, keyring, env, 1password].

planned_sha.description: Git SHA captured at envelope sign time. null until first sign.

superseded_by.description: Newer envelope id that supersedes this one (ADR-0011).

supersedes.description: Older envelope id this one supersedes (ADR-0011).

cross_project_rag.description: Allow find_similar_tasks etc. to read across projects. Privacy default OFF per ADR-0010.

flaky_quarantine_threshold.description: M/N — quarantine after M failures over N runs. Provisional 2/3 per ADR-0012.
